items.source: A component for QuerydslBindings customization acting as default customizer the given entity path regardless of the domain type. Instances can be registered with the application context to be applied.
items.translation: 一个用于 QuerydslBindings 自定义的组件，作为默认自定义器处理给定的实体路径，无论其领域类型如何。这些实例可以注册到应用程序上下文中以便应用。
